news.title: Class Changes, Enemy Spawn Adjustments, Item Tweaks: WoW Forever Hotfixes, November 13th
news.description: A big set of Forever hotfixes today, we have class changes, dungeon adjustments, quest improvements, spawn rate tweaks, and more!

news.title: Lost Skill Training Purchases After Server Issues Refunded
news.description: Players have received refunds after not receiving skills purchased during server instability on Monday, November 9th.

news.title: You Can Now Find Every Level 30-40 Dungeon Quest in WoW Forever
news.description: Five quest guides are live for WoW Forever dungeons in the 30-40 range, including new dungeons Drowned City and Krol’dok Stronghold.

news.title: Lothar, Doomhammer, and Turalyon: New WoW Forever Short Story, Cost of Honor
news.description: A new short story brings us the tale of the Siege of Blackrock Spire and more background on the Riverglades and the Brotherhood.

news.title: WoW Forever Players Are Arguing Over Who Should Roll Need on BoE Drops
news.description: Gold is scarce in WoW Forever, but so are upgrades. Here’s the case for and against rolling need on every Bind on Equip drop.

news.title: This Death Metal Guitarist Is Taking His WoW Forever Addiction on Tour
news.description: Death metal guitarist Justin McKinney proves WoW Forever addiction knows no limits, sneaking in an Undercity quest backstage.

news.title: WoW Forever Players Knocked Offline as DDoS Attack Hits Battle.net
news.description: WoW Forever players were caught up in a DDoS attack on Battle.net, leaving many disconnected and struggling to return to the game. Meanwhile, a massive PvP event had players questioning whether the servers could handle the chaos.

news.title: Blizzard Just Teased Playable Ogres for Horde Players
news.description: In the most recent episode of the WoW: Forever Podcast, Josh "Aggrend" Greenfield teased playable Ogres coming to the Horde.
